title: Kaash abbas mera
body:
baade ashoor ye zainab ke labon pe thi sada
kaash abbas mera maara gaya na hota
<<DIVIDER>>
pyas ke maare tadapti na sakina beti
baap ke kaandhe pe na bete ki mayyat hoti
yun na chalti mere shabbir ki gardan pe churi
is tarha ujda na hota ye gharana mera
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khelta asghar e baysheer mere aangan mein
haye cheh maah ka bacha nahi jaata ran mein
chid gaya nanha gala teer se uska ban mein
dushmano mein kya koi saahib e aulaad na tha
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maara gaya is dasht mein mera lashkar
qasim o aun o mohamed nahi na hai akbar
turbate asghar e baysheer bana kar sarwar
ashk se marqade baysheer ko sairaab kiya
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun imdad kare aata nahi koi nazar
betiyan jaati hai ahmed ki phirayi dar dar
baaghi keh keh ke chalate hai wo hum par pathar
yun na be-aas mohamed ka na hota kunba
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule koocha o bazaar phir aayi zainab
be rida shaam ke darbar mein aayi zainab
khoon ke ashk har ek pal hai bahayi zainab
dil mein gham leke bahattar ko hoo zinda bhaiya
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke seene pe soti thi sakina aksar
ab meinassar hai usay khaak ka takiya bistar
zaalimo kuch to taras khao meri bachi par
baap ki laadli hai baap ki shafqat se juda
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
chal basa mursale aazam ka gharana saara
haye zaalim ne sakina ko tamacha maara
bibiyan peet ke sar dene lagi ye naara
ghair hai charon taraf koi nahi hai apna
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis mein himmat thi mere baandta baazu mein rasan
noke naiza pe nahi hota sar e shaahe zaman
kitne khush haal raha karte thay hum apne watan
ye to acha hua karbal mein na aayi sughra
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar o asghar e baysheer na maare jaate
ek ek karke na nana ke dulaare jaate
sab mere saath watan aaj hamare jaate
haye zindan mein na rehti sakina tanha
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke karbal mein najaf zainab e muztar ka bayan
shaah ke laashe se bhi hone lagay ashk rawan
nehr pe tadpa udhar laasha e abbas e jawan
ashke afshan huwe matam mein idhar ahle aza
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
author: Najaf Murshidabadi
